The '''Quent Assassins''' were a [[Shockball/Legends|shockball]] team who once faced the [[Shad Furies/Legends|Shad Furies]] as part of the [[Imperial City Exhibition Series]].

Non-Human [[Ap Kormar]] was the center for this team.
